title: Which of sixteen reef sites the November 2027 post-bleaching survey visits: each site's 2027 season maximum degree heating weeks as the reprocessed record will give it, its alert level and how that compares with the level the weekly bulletins declared, with the hours each site's logger read at or above its maximum monthly mean over the 2024 to 2026 seasons
subdomain: environmental-monitoring-exceedance (coral bleaching heat stress: HotSpots above the maximum monthly mean, degree heating weeks and alert levels at a reef watch's sites)
prompt_shape: 01: a ranked list under a line, each site's expected season maximum degree heating weeks on the reprocessed record, its alert level and its verdict against the declared level, the survey list and its count, a chart of declared and expected heat stress against the alert levels, beside each site's hours at its logger at or above its maximum monthly mean

sources.origin: generated by task247/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional public university's reef station on the Caribbean coast of Quintana Roo: sixteen reef sites, a regional analysis centre's two daily SST products from 2018, the watch's 2027 weekly bulletins, the dive team's loggers and log, the 2023 post-bleaching survey's slates, the documents and the request; the university, the station, its sites, the analysis centre and every person are invented, the coral bleaching heat stress measures (HotSpots, degree heating weeks, alert levels) are the field's own, and no real dataset is reproduced.
